# SharedCanvas forwards no wheel, drag or modifier input to the renderer

## Context

`Neo.app.SharedCanvas` bridges the DOM to a canvas-worker renderer. Its interaction bridge forwards three facts: `mousemove` (`onMouseMove`, `src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs:234` at `2d993a26cb`), `click` (`onClick`, `:198`) and `mouseleave` (`onMouseLeave`, `:225`), each as `renderer.updateMouseState({x, y, click?, leave?, windowId})` with `x/y` relative to the cached `canvasRect`. The host owns no DOM listeners itself; its consumers subscribe and delegate (`apps/portal/view/services/Container.mjs:40` subscribes `mousemove` / `mouseleave` on the container and calls the canvas item's forwarders). `Neo.canvas.Base#updateMouseState` (`src/canvas/Base.mjs:206`) stores `mouse.x/y` and calls `onMouseClick`. Nothing else reaches the worker: no wheel, no button state, no modifier keys.

Operator direction (2026-09-24, D#19151): the graph observatory "would need zoom and rotate capabilities". An orbit camera is a drag (button down → move deltas → up) and zoom is the wheel (ctrl+wheel is the trackpad pinch on macOS); neither can be built on the host today, which is why the D#19151 witness rotates its scene on a timer. Any interactive renderer has the same gap (a scrubbable timeline, a pannable services map).

The complementary bridge stays as it is: `Neo.app.header.Canvas` measures sibling DOM rects and pushes them plus `hoverId` / `activeId` to its renderer (the canvas flows around real buttons), and the timeline host anchors nodes to avatar `-target` elements. This ticket adds the pointer-on-canvas half; DOM-anchored geometry and state bridging remain the consumer's pattern.

## The Problem

- No forwarder exists for `mousedown`, `mouseup` or `wheel`, although the main thread already delivers them (`src/main/DomEvents.mjs`: `mousedown :16`, `mouseup :19`, `wheel :21`, with `altKey, button, buttons, ctrlKey, metaKey, shiftKey` on every mouse event `:329–335` and `deltaX/deltaY/deltaZ` on wheel `:844–851`).
- The main thread forwards `wheel` only for a fixed class list (`globalWheelTargets`, `src/main/DomEvents.mjs:35`); a local `wheel` listener on any other node (`wheel: {local: true}`, the Helix precedent `src/component/Helix.mjs:293`) routes through the same `onWheel` (`src/manager/DomEvent.mjs` `handlerMap.wheel`) and is dropped when its node carries none of the listed classes. A canvas node carries none.
- The renderer receives absolute positions only, so a drag needs deltas the base does not compute; every subclass would keep its own last-position state.
- `updateMouseState` is the one remote input entry (`remote.app`, `src/canvas/Base.mjs:41`). New events must widen the payload, not add remote methods per event.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs` (App Worker): `onClick :198`, `onMouseLeave :225`, `onMouseMove :234`, `canvasRect` `:55`, `updateSize :272`; consumers subscribe DOM listeners and delegate.
- `src/canvas/Base.mjs` (Canvas Worker): `mouse = {x: -1000, y: -1000}` `:84`, `onMouseClick(data) {}` `:156`, `updateMouseState :206–220` (leave → off-screen; x/y; click → `onMouseClick`), `clearGraph :123` resets `mouse`.
- `src/main/DomEvents.mjs` (main thread): `onWheel :822` resolves its target through `testPathInclusion(event, globalWheelTargets)` and sends nothing without a match; a local listener fires with the node as `event.currentTarget` (`:859` already distinguishes it from the body listener).
- In-tree consumers of the input surface: `apps/portal/canvas/HomeCanvas.mjs:738` and `src/canvas/Header.mjs:961` override `onMouseClick`; the other renderers read `mouse.x/y` in their loops. All keep working: the new fields are additive and `click` keeps its shape. The four components with local wheel listeners (`DateSelector`, `Gallery`, `Helix`, `Circle`) are in the global list and match it first.
- Window groups (#19125): `windowId` stays on every payload.

## The Fix

`src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs`:

1. One protected `forwardPointer(data, extra)` builds the report — `windowId`, canvas-relative `x/y`, then `button`, `buttons` and the four modifiers when the event carries them — under the existing `isCanvasReady && canvasRect` guard.
2. `onClick` (`{click: true}`), `onMouseMove` (no extra), new `onMouseDown` (`{down: true}`), `onMouseUp` (`{up: true}`) and `onWheel` (`{wheel: {deltaMode, deltaX, deltaY, deltaZ}}`) call it. The class comment names the set and the subscription pattern (`wheel: {fn, local: true, passive: false}`).

`src/canvas/Base.mjs`:

3. `mouse` gains `dx`, `dy`, `buttons` and the four modifiers (an `idleMouseState()` helper is the one definition of the idle shape, used by the field, `clearGraph` and a leave). `updateMouseState` computes `dx/dy` against the previous on-canvas position, stores the facts the report carries, and dispatches `down` → `onMouseDown`, `up` → `onMouseUp`, `wheel` → `onWheel`, `click` → `onMouseClick`; a leave resets to idle and reaches no hook.
4. `onMouseDown`, `onMouseUp`, `onWheel` are no-op hooks beside `onMouseClick`.

`src/main/DomEvents.mjs`:

5. `onWheel` falls back to the local target (`getLocalWheelTarget`: `{cls: null, node: event.currentTarget}` when the listener is not the body's), so a node a component listens on locally receives deltas; the global list, its buffer and its keep-event behaviour are untouched.

Gestures (orbit, pan, pinch-zoom) stay in subclasses: the base forwards facts and deltas and owns no gesture state machine.

## Decision Record impact

`none`. D#19151 is the witness, not the authority: the change matches no `ideation-sandbox-workflow.md §5.2` high-blast trigger (three engine files, additive, single-PR).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 — `SharedCanvas` forwards `mousedown`, `mouseup` and `wheel` (deltas and modifiers) and adds `buttons` + modifiers to `mousemove`, all through `updateMouseState`, `x/y` relative to `canvasRect`, `windowId` on every payload; unit spec on the host with a recording renderer stub.
- [ ] AC-2 — `Neo.canvas.Base#updateMouseState` stores `buttons` and the modifiers, computes `dx/dy` per move, resets to idle on `leave`, keeps `click` → `onMouseClick`; `clearGraph` resets the shape; unit spec.
- [ ] AC-3 — `down`, `up` and `wheel` payloads reach `onMouseDown`, `onMouseUp`, `onWheel`; a subclass without overrides is unaffected (Header and the Portal canvases are not in the diff); unit spec, red-first per arm.
- [ ] AC-4 (outside CI, L3) — the D#19151 observatory witness orbits on drag and zooms on wheel through the base's hooks, its container subscribing `wheel` locally; receipt on D#19151.

## Out of Scope

- Touch and pointer events, pinch gestures, pointer capture for drags that leave the canvas — a v2 when a consumer needs them.
- Keyboard input.
- Gesture helpers (orbit, pan) in the base.
- Changing the global wheel target list or its throttle buffer.

## Gold Standards Rejected

- **One remote method per event.** Multiplies the remote surface and the window-group routing; one payload entry keeps `updateMouseState` the single input door.
- **A gesture recognizer in the base.** Every renderer maps input differently (orbit vs pan vs scrub); the base forwards facts and deltas.
- **Adding a canvas class to `globalWheelTargets`.** Every canvas would then post every wheel tick to the app worker, subscribed or not — the cost the list exists to avoid (wheel fires very often, and most of the time the user just wants to scroll); a local listener is opt-in per node.
- **Registering global wheel targets at runtime** (a `registerWheelTargets` remote beside `registerPreventDefaultTargets`, operator steer 2026-09-24). The right door if a global target is ever wanted; a canvas wants per-node opt-in, which the local listener already is.
- **Pointer Events instead of mouse events.** The main thread's `DomEvents` ships mouse and wheel today; pointer/touch is a v2 with its own main-thread work.
